name: Royalty Club Dating Simulator
source:
An exclusive VN in an alternate secret Lair of the Fooker Discord.
Help Royalty do... something... I don't know! Join in on his gay bara adventures full of complaining!
Made out of spite of a user in the LotF Discord. Pretty entertaining read for people who know him.
